textos.O meio-termo é o maior grupo da recepção: The middle ground is the largest reception group (~45% of ratings). The debate revolves around the narrative handling and the central figure: about half of those who recommend the film value the intimate approach to the protagonist, while most of those who do not recommend it disapprove of this portrayal. For most in the middling assessments, the discomfort lies in the exaggerated emphasis on the relationship with Josephine.
textos.As reviews negativas criticam a represen: The negative reviews criticize the depiction of Napoleon as a weak, submissive, infantilized character, reducing his historical figure to a caricature, which is considered an affront to the true strategist and leader.
textos.Muitos espectadores apontam que o filme: Many viewers point out that the film contains countless errors of dates, events and battles, which undermines historical fidelity and disappoints those who know Napoleon's real trajectory.
textos.O filme é descrito como lento, cansativo: The film is described as slow, tiring and poorly structured, with a fragmented narrative that skips events without giving context, making it hard for the audience to engage.
textos.Críticas negativas apontam que a relação: Negative reviews point out that the relationship with Josephine received more attention than the military and political achievements, leaving aside what truly made Napoleon a relevant historical figure.
textos.Embora alguns reconheçam o talento dos a: Although some acknowledge the actors' talent, many consider Joaquin Phoenix's casting unsuitable for the role, criticizing his age and lack of charisma, while Vanessa Kirby is praised for her performance.
textos.As cenas de batalha são apontadas como v: The battle scenes are pointed to as visually impressive, but lacking strategy and tactics, often being confusing and without the military brilliance that characterized Napoleon.
textos.As sequências de batalha são amplamente: The battle sequences are widely praised for their grandeur and competent direction, being the film's high point for most viewers in this group.
textos.O filme se arrasta em várias partes, com: The film drags in several parts, with a saggy middle and a feeling that screen time is poorly used; many consider the extended version even more tiring, despite some improvements.
textos.Foco excessivo no relacionamento com Jos: Excessive focus on the relationship with Josephine
textos.O filme dedica uma parcela desproporcion: The film devotes a disproportionate share of its time to the romance between Napoleon and Josephine, at the expense of his military and political career, which displeases viewers who expected a more comprehensive portrayal.
textos.Várias pessoas apontam que o longa disto: Several people point out that the film distorts real events, omits important events and takes creative liberties that compromise historical accuracy, which is disappointing for those who know the character's trajectory.
textos.Atuações de destaque, especialmente de P: Standout performances, especially from Phoenix and Kirby
textos.Joaquin Phoenix e Vanessa Kirby recebem: Joaquin Phoenix and Vanessa Kirby receive praise for their performances, even though some think Phoenix is not entirely convincing as Napoleon or that the construction of the characters is superficial.
textos.Construção de personagem fraca e falta d: Weak character building and lack of political depth
textos.O filme não consegue transmitir a comple: The film fails to convey Napoleon's complexity as a strategist and leader, reducing him to a man obsessed with his wife, while relevant political and military aspects are treated superficially.
textos.Atuações e carisma de Joaquin Phoenix e: Performances and charisma of Joaquin Phoenix and Vanessa Kirby
textos.A performance de Joaquin Phoenix foi elo: Joaquin Phoenix's performance was praised for capturing the character's duality, moving between vulnerability and authority, while Vanessa Kirby stood out for giving depth to Josephine.
textos.A fotografia, os figurinos e os cenários: The cinematography, costumes and sets were described as stunning, creating immersion in nineteenth-century France and elevating the film's visual experience.
textos.As sequências de batalha foram considera: The battle sequences were considered spectacular and brutal, with authentic choreography that shows the best of Ridley Scott in large-scale combat.
textos.Abordagem pessoal e íntima do personagem: Personal, intimate approach to the character
textos.O filme foi apreciado por focar nas inse: The film was appreciated for focusing on Napoleon's insecurities and personal life, presenting him as an ordinary man with flaws rather than a mythological hero.
textos.A versão estendida foi elogiada por melh: The extended version was praised for improving the pace, giving more depth to the events, while the original version seemed to rush through some historical milestones.
textos.O filme despertou a curiosidade dos espe: The film sparked viewers' curiosity, leading them to research Napoleon and the historical context on their own, which was a positive for them.

textos.Dirigido por Ridley Scott e lançado em 2: Directed by Ridley Scott and released in 2023, Napoleon is a historical war drama that presents the origins of the French military leader and his rapid, relentless rise to emperor. The narrative explores this trajectory through the prism of the dependent, volatile relationship between Napoleon and his wife, Josephine.
textos.A experiência do longa é estruturada pel: The film's experience is structured by a constant alternation between grand stagings of military clashes and passages devoted to the intimacy of the protagonist couple. The setting reconstructs the era of the French Empire, spanning decades of events in a long-running narrative.
textos.Em boa parte das notas (~45%), uma parce: In a good portion of the ratings (~45%), a significant share praises the grandeur and technical execution of the battle scenes as the work's standout moments. However, several point to an uneven pace and a sense of excess in the narrative's total length, while a portion lament what they consider an excessive focus on the romance with Josephine at the expense of the period's political and military complexities.
textos.Numa parte menor das notas (~33%), algun: In a smaller portion of the ratings (~33%), some positively highlight the performances and charisma of Joaquin Phoenix and Vanessa Kirby in the lead roles. For them, a portion of them stress the visual impact built through the art direction, sets and period costumes, while a smaller slice celebrates the vigor and quality of the large combat sequences.
textos.Para a visão expressa numa parcela das n: For the view expressed in a share of the ratings (~22%), where negative emotional impact predominates, many criticize the way Napoleon is portrayed in the plot, considering the character weakened or caricatured. In addition, a considerable number condemn the historical inaccuracies and licenses in the work, while some point to flaws in pacing and editing as factors that fragment the narrative.
